svg.title: S3-Zero HUB75 level shifter wiring
svg.desc: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero driving a HUB75E panel through four SN74AHCT125N buffers powered from 5V. All fourteen panel signals and the WS2812B strip data line are buffered.
svg.text: ANIMATED PIXEL CLOCK • DIY S3-ZERO BOARD
14 HUB75 signals + WS2812B data • env matrix-s3
One 5V supply feeds the ESP, the buffer chips and the panel. All grounds are common.
Panel and LED strip power go by their own cables straight from the supply, never through the ESP, the chips or the ribbon.
02 BUFFER CHIPS (top view, notch up, pin 1 top-left)
A = input from ESP (3.3V) • Y = output to panel (5V) • every ~OE LOW = always enabled
Pin 14 → +5V, pin 7 → GND, 100nF from 14 to 7 close to the chip
Pin 14 → +5V, pin 7 → GND, 100nF from 14 to 7 close to the chip
Pin 14 → +5V, pin 7 → GND, 100nF from 14 to 7 close to the chip
Pin 14 → +5V, pin 7 → GND, 100nF from 14 to 7 close to the chip
Every signal pin is fed from a buffer Y output. Check the pin-1 mark on the panel PCB before wiring.
AHCT inputs switch at TTL levels (VIH 2.0V), so 3.3V GPIO drives them cleanly and the outputs swing to 5V.
Use AHCT or HCT only; plain HC/AC at 5V do not reliably accept 3.3V. Unused A inputs to GND, unused Y outputs open.
Keep ESP → chip and chip → panel wires short, CLK shortest. Never power the chips from 3.3V.
WS2812B: U4 3A ← GPIO 17 (set LED pin to 17 in the portal), 3Y → 330Ω at the strip end → DIN. Strip +5V/GND from the supply, GND common.
GPIO 17 chosen over the default 21 (S3-Zero onboard RGB LED) and 46 (boot strap). Firmware default stays 21, so change it once in the portal.
Firmware for the NONDK panel after the buffer: driver 0 (generic), color depth 8, min refresh 60 (Display panel card).
Sources: src/display/hub75_pins.h default map, SN74AHCT125 datasheet pinout, HUB75E pinout
